description: Preview of the ClearMind 401(k) Scorecard for one plan: overall 0-100 score, band (Strength, Monitor, Priority), headline, and a short story of the plan, scored from its latest public Form 5500-SF filing, with the filing date and data source. Not an audit or compliance determination. The full five-area breakdown is on the Scorecard page, not returned here. No auth. Step 2 of 2: get the plan_id from find_401k_plan first; an unknown plan_id returns an error that says so.

plan_id.description: plan_id from find_401k_plan: 9-digit EIN plus 3-digit plan number, e.g. 341401001-001. The dash is optional.
